title: Hollow Knight
notes: Precise combat, exploration with a voice of its own. The late backtracking drags a little.

title: Cuphead
notes: Hard but always legible: when you die you know why. The art and the music are half the game.

title: No Man's Sky
notes: Beautiful to look at, but nothing sticks in all that procedural vastness.

title: Some Sequel Or Other
notes: Finished it for the trophies only. Competent and forgettable: an example of writing a low rating down plainly.
